profile.headline: Software Developer | Arup
profile.summary:
Software Developer with 4 years of experience building scalable web applications, developing data-driven solutions, and creating robust .NET applications. Proficient in developing full-stack web solutions with JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, and Node.js; utilizing Python for data analytics, automation, and web development; delivering enterprise-grade software with C# and .NET; and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Experienced in working with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products and services. Always eager to tackle new challenges and expand technical expertise.

TECHNICAL EXPERTISE:
⇨ CODING LANGUAGES: Javascript/Typescript, Python, C, C#, C++, java,
html/CSS, Swift, SQL, GLSL
⇨ WEB APPLICATIONS / MOBILE DEVELOPMENT: Node.js,
Express, React, PostgreSQL, iOS, Android, Docker
⇨ ADDITIONAL INDUSTRY EXPERTISE: Data Analytics/Visualization, Machine
Learning, JIRA, Distributed Systems and Big Data, Unity
Development, Automation, 

LET’S CONNECT: Please contact me through LinkedIn or at
theericota@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
I was awarded a summer internship with WANdisco in 2017 and after making a strong impression was invited to return in 2018 for a 2nd summer internship due to my excellent work performance and effective team collaborations.

⇨ Drafted the design document, outlined problems and bugs, proposed solutions, and spearheaded the development of a canary testing package that was approved and integrated into a Live Data product.
⇨ Presented canary testing solution to an international engineering team and was recognized for the contribution to the Live Data product.
⇨ Studied the workflow of a full software engineering team and collaborated on the codebase of a large-scale product.
⇨ Developed a REST API that provided an opportunity to explore various parts of the code and gained hands-on experience writing professional code.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: With YBCA, I assisted with installing their new Wi-Fi infrastructure which included installing routers, wiring, configuration, and testing. I worked with an IT team to correct hardware problems, respond to technical issues from various departments, install software, and perform other maintenance tasks.

company.name: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts

positions.title: Computer Technician Intern
positions.description: I worked as a Computer Technician and focused on diagnosing and repairing a broad range of computer issues. Additionally, I built and sold computers and hardware created from donated or salvaged parts.
